scope: Power Up Super Fighting Sun duration reconciliation

records.name: Fighting Sun
records.unlock_method: Skill Shop after completing Universal Emperor
records.reason: Current XV2 individual documentation has a 15-second displayed Stats duration but its Properties section explicitly states that the all-stat boost lasts 18 seconds. The repository should preserve both fields rather than silently choosing one. The 18-second property value describes the actual effect duration; 15 seconds is the displayed stat value.

reconciliation_note: This resolves the previous Batch 243 uncertainty without claiming the two source fields are identical. Current documentation also confirms the Skill Shop acquisition after Universal Emperor and 0 Ki cost.
